dogecoin.text: The bottom line is that Tesla is more important to @elonmusk than any crypto including Dogecoin.  Fact remains, there are still outstanding questions regarding sustainability and $BTC.  Given Tesla’s and @elonmusk position on the global stage, they can’t operate in the gray area.
That happens in many walks of life.  If @elonmusk wants to explore $DOGE, then that’s part of his journey.  And maybe it doesn’t include $BTC.  That’s fine too.
